subject: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial

Samir,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. As promised, I attached a compact mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses on what Medify and Redwood will each own during the 4-week trial and, importantly, the acceptance assertions we’ll use to evaluate readiness to move to a paid Dedicated offering.

Key asks inside the MAP:
- Define 3 success signals (latency & throughput, anonymized concordance, and integration stability)
- Exit gates required to consider the trial a success (automated smoke tests pass, <1% classification drift on sample set, and SOC2 evidence on logging)
- Owners and due-dates for artifacts (SOC2 summary, sample test vectors, and integration checklist)

Would you and procurement be comfortable with the artifacts called out? If yes, we’ll finalize the MAP and propose a mutual sign-off date.

Attachments: redwood-map-draft.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Naomi\Naomi Feldman\Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0142
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medifyhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial

Naomi —

Thanks for the MAP. High level looks good. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side before we commit:

1) SOC2: we need a short evidence summary (not full report). Can you provide a 1-pager that explains logging, access controls, and retention? Procurement will want that.
2) Smoke tests: can you give us the smoke test vector names and the pass thresholds you propose? We want to run them from our staging environment.
3) Cutover criteria: if one of the three signals fails but the other two pass, do you allow a remediation sprint + re-run, or is it an automatic fail?

Cc'ing contracts (contracts@medifyhealth.com) so they can flag any procurement redlines early.

If you can send the SOC2 summary and a CSV of smoke vectors, we can review and respond by Monday.

—Samir
Samir Gupta\Product Lead, Medify Health\samir.gupta@medifyhealth.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial (internal)

Team —

Forwarding Samir's questions. Action items:
- Marissa: can you produce a one-page SOC2 evidence summary (logging, access controls, retention) we can share with procurement? Target: Mon 07/05.
- Ben: please export the smoke test vectors (subset) and a CSV with pass thresholds. Samir asked to run from their staging; include a one-line runbook. Target: Mon 07/05.
- Naomi (me): I’ll draft the remediation policy text for the MAP: propose "remediation window + re-run" for single-signal failures unless there is a security/compliance block.

We should also upload the MAP draft and artifacts to the shared drive and add to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — please confirm owners and ETA.

Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medifyhealth.com>, contracts <contracts@medifyhealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial

Samir —

Attached are the artifacts requested: a one-page SOC2 summary and a CSV with 12 smoke test vectors + pass thresholds. I also updated the MAP with a short remediation policy: if a single operational metric (latency or throughput) misses threshold by <=10% we allow one remediation sprint (3 business days) and then a re-run of the smoke suite. Any security or audit-related failure is a hard stop and requires sign-off from both sides.

Attachments: SOC2-type2-summary.pdf (application/pdf); smoke-tests-sample.csv (text/csv); MUTUAL_ACTIONS.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Runbook (one-liner): run smoke-tests-sample.csv against staging endpoint (https://staging-api.medifyhealth.com/v1/gen) with 50 concurrent requests for 2 minutes; failures must be documented in the attached CSV and uploaded to the shared drive link below.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-medify-map

If procurement needs anything else, flag here and we’ll respond.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole\Director, Solutions Operations, Redwood Inference\marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medifyhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, contracts <contracts@medifyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual success checklist + acceptance assertions for trial

Naomi / Marissa —

This is exactly what procurement and engineering needed. We reviewed the SOC2 summary and smoke vectors; the remediation window and re-run policy works for us. Contracts, please proceed with the standard POC SOW referencing DEAL-9831 and include the MAP and SOC2 summary as exhibits.

We’ll aim to start the trial on Monday 07/12. I’ll upload a signed mutual action stub to the shared drive after procurement confirms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Samir
